verdicts.decision_note: The message establishes the spreadsheet as the lead-tracking data repository; the downstream HubSpot-entry condition belongs to the separate secured-lead Requirement.
The client explicitly changes the spreadsheet data-inclusion rule to include only responding leads.
Message 293 narrows the lead-inclusion rule to hosts interested in moving forward with content, and message 294 unambiguously identifies the spreadsheet as the target.
The source changes when a lead is entered into HubSpot, not the Airbnb spreadsheet's storage or inclusion behavior.

missing_event_candidates.description: The message indicates that spreadsheet information is used for downstream entry when a host is ready to schedule; verify this lifecycle event under the HubSpot-entry Requirement.
The client changes the HubSpot-entry condition so a lead is entered only after the arrangement is completely secured.
